description: This file defines data structures, macros, and constants for pin control configuration specific to Renesas R-Car Gen3 SoC in the Zephyr project. It includes definitions for pin functions, flags, and utility macros for initializing and managing pin settings.

methods.name: RCAR_IPSR
methods.description: Macro to get the IPSR property from device tree node.

methods.name: RCAR_HAS_IPSR
methods.description: Macro to check if the device tree node has IPSR property.

methods.name: RCAR_PIN_FUNC
methods.description: Macro to extract pin function information from device tree node.

methods.name: RCAR_PIN_FLAGS
methods.description: Macro to determine pin flags based on device tree properties.

methods.name: RCAR_DT_PIN
methods.description: Macro to initialize a pin structure from device tree node.

methods.name: Z_PINCTRL_STATE_PIN_INIT
methods.description: Macro to initialize a pin with specific state property and index.

methods.name: Z_PINCTRL_STATE_PINS_INIT
methods.description: Macro to initialize multiple pins from a property.

methods.name: RCAR_IS_GP_PIN
methods.description: Macro to check if a pin is GPIO capable.
